text:
Jules: quick FYI — the in-app help drawer labels the flow 'Create route' but our docs and glossary use 'endpoint'. noticed it during a usability run.
Tara (Docs): thanks — which drawer exactly? can you paste the path or screenshot?
Jules: Console > Integrations > Routing > New drawer (right-hand). header reads 'Create route' and the first example shows 'route id'.
Ravi - Frontend: good catch. our deep-linking relies on canonical heading slugs; mismatch could mean the drawer's in-panel links 404 or jump to the wrong place.
Tara (Docs): i'd prefer 'endpoint' as canonical term. propose updating drawer copy to 'Create endpoint' and adding an alias note at the top of the docs like "Terminology: endpoint (formerly called 'route')" for a transition period.
Lina (A11y): accessibility note: when someone clicks a deep link in the drawer, screen readers aren't being notified and keyboard focus stays in the drawer. we need to close the drawer, move focus programmatically to the destination heading, and/or use an aria-live region.
Ravi - Frontend: implementation plan: on deep-link click -> close drawer, set aria-hidden=true on drawer, update url hash, then focus the target heading with tabindex=-1 and el.focus(). will add a short delay (100ms) to allow SPA routing.
Tara (Docs): i'll add explicit anchor IDs where needed and a short alias line at the top of each affected article. i'll also compile a list of all pages mentioning 'route' so we can batch-audit.
Jules: can we include a tiny 'open in docs' chain icon next to in-drawer section headers that does the deep link? users seem to expect that affordance.
Lina (A11y): same-tab nav is fine if focus management is robust. if we open a new tab, the icon must include an aria-label that says '(opens in new tab)' and use rel=noopener. ensure focus styles are visible for keyboard.
Ravi - Frontend: filing ticket INFRA-9999 with acceptance criteria: 1) drawer copy changed to 'endpoint'; 2) docs alias line; 3) add deep-link icon in drawer; 4) focus management + aria-hidden toggles; 5) analytics event fired on link click. will attach unit + e2e tests.
docship-bot: created INFRA-9999: "Help drawer terminology cleanup + deep-link a11y" assigned to Ravi - Frontend, due in 5 days.
Tara (Docs): thanks — i'll queue the copy PR and share the 'route' occurrences doc.
Jules: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
